"The fluorescent hum of Aisle 4 was the only soundtrack. Mrs. Gable stood frozen, a tin of crushed tomatoes hovering mid-air, her knuckles white against the cold metal. "I remember you crying over it," she countered, though her voice lacked its old edge.
